comment: Human pixel-avatar art (Oscar, avatar-layers v3.3), one file for every consumer: packages/shared/src/humanAvatar.ts composes it for the web builder/avatars and the Server's SVG route. Each layer option is a size x size grid of role indices, one string per row, one character per cell: 0-9, then a-z for roles 10-35 (0 transparent; roles below). Colours: role 2 from palettes.skin, role 4 from palettes.hair, the background fills the square from palettes.background, every other role from fixed (roleColors maps a role to its fixed key). Draw order: background, base, expression (an empty layer is the base's own face), hair, accessories by ascending z. Recipe ids (pixel-human:v1:...) are mapped to these option names in humanAvatar.ts; renaming an option here needs that map updated, never the stored ids.
